source.name: Minnesota United: 'Minnesota United Scores Historic First with NutriSource and Finley's as Jersey Sleeve Sponsors'
source.quote: Minnesota United today introduced a groundbreaking, multi-year partnership with Minnesota-based NutriSource Pet Foods and Finley’s Pet Treats
source.note: The page's publication date (2025-05-08) is from its datePublished metadata; the page body shows no date line. The club calls it a multi-year partnership but discloses no value or end date.
